answer: Locks are written down in kernel, expire in pulse, and voyage lists each expiry. Someone running 12 aliases as a result needs 138 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2922 identities would post 2036 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
